name: Tooltip
summary: A small label that appears on hover or focus to name or briefly explain a control.

anatomy.purpose: The element that has focus or hover.
Short text, one or two lines.

whenToUse: Naming icon-only controls and giving a short extra hint.
whenNotToUse: Important information: put it on the page.
Touch devices: there is no hover, so do not depend on tooltips.

accessibility.focus: Do not move focus into the tooltip.
notes: Dismissible and persistent until hover ends.
Never put links or buttons inside.
